description: Daily observed weather for named NOAA stations — max/min temperature, precipitation, snowfall, snow depth, wind and more, from the GHCN-Daily record that runs back to the 1800s at long-lived stations. AUTHORITATIVE for "how hot/wet was it on this date at this place"; PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for any historical US daily weather value. Sourced from the NOAA NCEI Access Data Service.

dataTypes.description: Comma-separated element codes, e.g. "TMAX,TMIN,PRCP,SNOW,AWND". Omit for every element the station reports.

limit.description: Max daily rows to return (default 400, max 5000)

stations.description: GHCN station id(s), comma-separated, e.g. "USW00023174" (LAX) or "USW00023174,USW00014922". Find them with ncei_station_search.

name: ncei_daily_summaries
